Semantics of expressions on bit-fields

A bit-field has no address, so no rule of wp_lval, wp_xval or wp_glval applies to a bit-field glvalue. Bit-field glvalues have their own nodes (see Ebf_glvalue in ../syntax/core.v), which are evaluated by wp_bitfield_glval (see ../logic/wp.v): it yields the pointer to the enclosing object and, for a bit-field, a bf_designator.
The rules are stated on those nodes only, so the head constructor of an expression determines which rules apply:
  • the leaf rule for Ebitfield;
  • Ebf_glvalue, the ordinary arm of a bit-field conditional, with no designator;
  • Ebf_comma, Ebf_if, Ebf_assign, Ebf_assign_op, Ebf_preinc and Ebf_predec, which evaluate their glvalue operand with wp_bitfield_glval;
  • the consumers Cl2r_bitfield, Ebf_postinc and Ebf_postdec. Discarded-value expressions use wp_bitfield_glval directly (see wp_discard and is_bf_glvalue).
Each rule evaluates its operands exactly like the existing rule for the construct it mirrors, and its access to an ordinary object (None) is exactly the existing one. Existing rules are unchanged, and no rule of wp_lval, wp_xval, wp_operand or wp_init applies to the new glvalue nodes.

#[local] Open Scope free_scope.

Module bitfield_expr.

info_ok info ty checks that info describes a bit-field of declared type ty as cpp2v emits it: a standard integer type of the recorded signedness, and a nonzero width no larger than that type's. Then the values in range for info are values of type ty.
  Definition info_ok (info : BitfieldInfo) (ty : type) : bool :=
    bool_decide (drop_qualifiers ty = drop_qualifiers info.(bf_type)) &&
    match drop_qualifiers info.(bf_type) with
    | Tnum sz sgn =>
        bool_decide (sgn = info.(bf_signed)) &&
        bool_decide (info.(bf_width) <> 0)%N &&
        bool_decide (info.(bf_width) <= bitsize.bitsN (int_rank.bitsize sz))%N
    | _ => false
    end.

promoted_type tu info is the type to which the integral promotions convert a value of the bit-field info (<https://eel.is/c++draft/conv.prom5>): <> if it can represent all values of the bit-field, otherwise <> if it can, and otherwise the promotion of the declared type.
  Definition promoted_type (tu : translation_unit) (info : BitfieldInfo) : option type :=
    let int_bits := bitsize.bitsN (int_rank.bitsize int_rank.Iint) in
    let w := info.(bf_width) in
    match info.(bf_signed) with
    | Signed =>
        if bool_decide (w <= int_bits)%N then Some Tint
        else promote_integral tu info.(bf_type)
    | Unsigned =>
        if bool_decide (w < int_bits)%N then Some Tint
        else if bool_decide (w <= int_bits)%N then Some Tuint
        else promote_integral tu info.(bf_type)
    end.

End bitfield_expr.

Access primitives

r : ptr * option bf_designator is the result of wp_bitfield_glval: (p, Some d) for the bit-field d of the object at p, (p, None) for the ordinary object at p.
Section access.
  Context `{Σ : cpp_logic} {σ : genv} (tu : translation_unit).

bf_read ty r Q reads the value of r, of erased type ty. For an ordinary object this is the body of wp_operand_cast_l2r.
  Definition bf_read (ty : type) (r : ptr * option bf_designator) (Q : val -> mpred) : mpred :=
    match r with
    | (p, None) =>
        Exists v, (Exists q, p |-> initializedR ty q v ** True) //\\ Q v
    | (p, Some d) =>
        Exists q cs m v,
          (p |-> bitfieldsR d.(bfd_cls) d.(bfd_info).(bf_run) q cs m **
           [| m !! d.(bfd_field) = Some v |] ** True) //\\
          Q (Vint v)
    end.

bf_write ty r rv Q stores rv into r, of erased type ty, then continues as Q. For an ordinary object this is the body of wp_lval_assign. A bit-field needs its whole memory location, and stores the value reduced to its width.
  Definition bf_write (ty : type) (r : ptr * option bf_designator) (rv : val) (Q : mpred) : mpred :=
    match r with
    | (p, None) =>
        p |-> anyR ty 1$m ** (p |-> tptstoR ty 1$m rv -* Q)
    | (p, Some d) =>
        let cls := d.(bfd_cls) in
        let run := d.(bfd_info).(bf_run) in
        let f := d.(bfd_field) in
        Exists z cs m,
          [| rv = Vint z |] ** [| cs !! f = Some false |] **
          p |-> bitfieldsR cls run 1 cs m **
          (p |-> bitfieldsR cls run 1 cs
                   (<[f := bitfield.trunc d.(bfd_info).(bf_signed) d.(bfd_info).(bf_width) z]> m)
           -* Q)
    end.

bf_update pty ty r v v' Q replaces the value v of r, of erased type ty, by v' (reduced to the width of a bit-field), then continues as Q. For an ordinary object this is the primR update of wp_lval_bop_assign, pre_op and post_op.
v' was computed after promoting v as a value of type pty. The integral promotions of a bit-field depend on its width (<https://eel.is/c++draft/conv.prom5>), so for a bit-field this requires them to agree with those of [pty].
  Definition bf_update (pty ty : type) (r : ptr * option bf_designator) (v v' : val) (Q : mpred) : mpred :=
    match r with
    | (p, None) =>
        p |-> primR ty 1$m v ** (p |-> primR ty 1$m v' -* Q)
    | (p, Some d) =>
        let cls := d.(bfd_cls) in
        let run := d.(bfd_info).(bf_run) in
        let f := d.(bfd_field) in
        Exists z z' cs m,
          [| bitfield_expr.promoted_type tu d.(bfd_info) = promote_integral tu pty |] **
          [| v = Vint z |] ** [| v' = Vint z' |] **
          [| m !! f = Some z |] ** [| cs !! f = Some false |] **
          p |-> bitfieldsR cls run 1 cs m **
          (p |-> bitfieldsR cls run 1 cs
                   (<[f := bitfield.trunc d.(bfd_info).(bf_signed) d.(bfd_info).(bf_width) z']> m)
           -* Q)
    end.
End access.

Module Type Expr__bitfield.
  (* Needed for Unfold wp_test *)
  #[local] Arguments wp_test [_ _ _ _] _ _ _.

  Section with_resolve.
    Context `{Σ : cpp_logic} {resolve:genv}.
    Variables (tu : translation_unit) (ρ : region).

    #[local] Notation wp_glval := (wp_glval tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation wp_operand := (wp_operand tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation wp_test := (wp_test tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation wp_discard := (wp_discard tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation wp_bitfield_glval := (wp_bitfield_glval tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation read_arrow := (read_arrow tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation inc_dec_op := (inc_dec_op tu).
    #[local] Notation bf_update := (bf_update tu).

The leaf: a.f (a->f if arrow) for a bit-field f that the translation unit describes. It designates f of the object a denotes; neither a nor f is accessed. Compare wp_lval_member.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_member : forall arrow a f ty vc cv cls info Q,
        arrow_aggregate_type arrow (decltype_of_expr a) = Some (vc, cv, cls) ->
        bitfield_lookup tu cls f = Some info ->
        bitfield_expr.info_ok info ty = true ->
          (letI* base, free := read_arrow arrow a in
           Q (base, Some (Build_bf_designator cls f info)) free)
      |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebitfield arrow a f ty) Q.

An ordinary glvalue as an arm of a bit-field conditional: it denotes an ordinary object.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_glvalue : forall e Q,
        wp_glval e (fun p free => Q (p, None) free)
      |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_glvalue e) Q.

e1, e2: compare wp_lval_comma.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_comma : forall e1 e2 Q,
        wp_discard e1 (fun free1 => wp_bitfield_glval e2 (fun r free2 => Q r (free2 >*> free1)))
      |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_comma e1 e2) Q.

c ? e1 : e2: compare wp_lval_condition. Each arm is evaluated by wp_bitfield_glval, so the result may designate a bit-field or not, depending on c.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_condition : forall ty tst th el Q,
        Unfold WPE.wp_test (wp_test tst (fun c free =>
           if c
           then wp_bitfield_glval th (fun v free' => Q v (free' >*> free))
           else wp_bitfield_glval el (fun v free' => Q v (free' >*> free))))
      |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_if tst th el ty) Q.

l = r: compare wp_lval_assign. The result designates l.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_assign : forall ty l r Q,
        (letI* '(lr, rv), free :=
           eval2 (evaluation_order.order_of (language_version tu) OOEqual)
             (wp_bitfield_glval l) (wp_operand r) in
         bf_write (erase_qualifiers ty) lr rv (Q lr free))
      |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_assign l r ty) Q.

l op= r: compare wp_lval_bop_assign.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_bop_assign : forall ty o oo l r Q,
        to_operator_equal o = Some oo ->
        match convert_type_op tu o (type_of l) (type_of r) with
        | Some (tl, tr, resultT) =>
          letI* '(lr, rv), free :=
            eval2 (evaluation_order.order_of (language_version tu) oo)
              (wp_bitfield_glval l) (wp_operand r) in
          Exists lv clv resv storedv,
            ([| convert tu (type_of l) tl lv clv |] **
             [| tr = type_of r |] **
             eval_binop tu o tl tr resultT clv rv resv **
             [| convert tu resultT ty resv storedv |] ** True) //\\
            bf_update (type_of l) (erase_qualifiers ty) lr lv storedv (Q lr free)
        | _ => False%I
        end
      |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_assign_op o l r ty) Q.

Pre-increment and pre-decrement: compare pre_op.
    Definition bf_pre_op (b : BinOp) (ty : type) (e : Expr)
        (Q : ptr * option bf_designator -> FreeTemps.t -> mpred) : mpred :=
      let ety := erase_qualifiers $ type_of e in
      wp_bitfield_glval e (fun r free => Exists v v',
        (inc_dec_op b ety v v' ** True) //\\
        bf_update ety ety r v v' (Q r free)).

++e: compare wp_lval_preinc.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_preinc : forall e ty Q,
        bf_pre_op Badd ty e Q |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_preinc e ty) Q.

--e: compare wp_lval_predec.
    Axiom wp_bitfield_glval_predec : forall e ty Q,
        bf_pre_op Bsub ty e Q |-- wp_bitfield_glval (Ebf_predec e ty) Q.

Consumers

The lvalue-to-rvalue conversion of a bit-field glvalue: compare wp_operand_cast_l2r.
    Axiom wp_operand_cast_l2r_bitfield : forall e Q,
        (letI* r, free := wp_bitfield_glval e in
         bf_read (erase_qualifiers $ type_of e) r (fun v => Q v free))
      |-- wp_operand (Ecast Cl2r_bitfield e) Q.

Post-increment and post-decrement: compare post_op. The value is the old one.
    Definition bf_post_op (b : BinOp) (ty : type) (e : Expr)
        (Q : val -> FreeTemps.t -> mpred) : mpred :=
      let ety := erase_qualifiers $ type_of e in
      wp_bitfield_glval e (fun r free => Exists v v',
        (inc_dec_op b ety v v' ** True) //\\
        bf_update ety ety r v v' (Q v free)).

e++: compare wp_operand_postinc.
    Axiom wp_operand_postinc_bitfield : forall e ty Q,
        bf_post_op Badd ty e Q |-- wp_operand (Ebf_postinc e ty) Q.

e--: compare wp_operand_postdec.
    Axiom wp_operand_postdec_bitfield : forall e ty Q,
        bf_post_op Bsub ty e Q |-- wp_operand (Ebf_postdec e ty) Q.

  End with_resolve.
End Expr__bitfield.
